title: 第9章 妖孽受死第10章 踢到铁板了
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
“啊？!”
林清瑶直接瞪大了眼睛。
让我去杀那条二阶妖蛇？!
师兄难道不清楚我昨日才筑基吗？
这分明是让我去送死啊！
然而就在这个想法出现的一瞬间，林清瑶就立马反应了过来。
等等！
师兄是何等人物？
他岂会不知我与那妖蛇的实力差距？
师兄既然开口让我去，定然有其深意！
没错了，师兄绝非让我送死！
这是师兄对我的考验！
是磨砺我的道心与战意！
师兄定是想看看，我在绝境之下能否爆发出潜能，能否坚守道心，是否值得他悉心栽培！
我若此刻露怯退缩，表现出丝毫恐惧，师兄定然会对我大失所望！
之前的所有好感与机缘，恐怕都将付诸东流！
想到此处，林清瑶眼神中的恐惧瞬间消散。
比起面对妖蛇的恐惧，她更害怕失去这来之不易的仙缘！
旋即，她深吸一口气，重重地点头：“是！
师兄！

师妹明白了！”
陆鸣见她答应也是心中一喜，当即就道：
“好！
那你便出去与它搏杀。”
“记住，若是中了毒，便立刻退回院中，师兄自会为你疗伤。”
说着，陆鸣顿了顿，语气加重，格外严肃道：
“但在那妖蛇主动踏入此院之前，你莫要盼望师兄会出手。”
“因为，这是师兄对你的考验！”
陆鸣想的很简单，林倩瑶要是中毒自己随时可以为她解毒。
假如她将那妖蛇逼的不耐烦，使得妖蛇主动进入小院那是最好。
一旦进入领域，自己便可斩草除根，杀掉妖蛇。
而听到陆鸣话的林清瑶心中一动。
果然！
师兄就是要我在生死之间寻求突破！
如此用心良苦，我绝不能辜负！
念及于此，她郑重应道：“是！
师兄！
师妹定当竭尽全力，不负师兄考验！”
content_en:
"Ah?!"
Lin Qingyao's eyes widened.
Want me to kill that second-level demonic snake? !
Doesn’t Senior Brother know that I just built the foundation yesterday?
This is obviously asking me to die!
However, the moment this idea appeared, Lin Qingyao immediately reacted.
etc!
What kind of person is your senior brother?
How could he not know the difference in strength between me and that demonic snake?
Since senior brother asked me to go, he must have a deep meaning!
That's right, senior brother is definitely not asking me to die!
This is my senior brother’s test!
It is to sharpen my Taoist heart and fighting spirit!
Senior brother must want to see if I can unleash my potential in a desperate situation, if I can stick to my Taoist heart, and if I am worthy of his careful cultivation!
If I shrink back and show any fear at this moment, senior brother will definitely be disappointed in me!
All the goodwill and opportunities I had before may be in vain!
Thinking of this, the fear in Lin Qingyao's eyes instantly dissipated.
Compared with the fear of facing the demon snake, she is more afraid of losing this hard-won immortality!
Immediately, she took a deep breath and nodded heavily: "Yes!
Senior brother!
Junior sister understands! "
Lu Ming was very happy when he saw her agree, and immediately said:
"Okay!
Then go out and fight it. "
"Remember, if you are poisoned, return to the hospital immediately, and your senior brother will heal you."
As he spoke, Lu Ming paused, his tone became more serious, and he said in an extremely serious tone:
"But before that demonic snake takes the initiative to step into this hospital, don't expect your senior brother to take action."
"Because, this is senior brother's test for you!"
Lu Ming thought simply. If Lin Qianyao was poisoned, he could detoxify her at any time.
It would be best if she made the demonic snake impatient and made it take the initiative to enter the courtyard.
Once you enter the realm, you can eradicate the roots and kill the demonic snake.
Lin Qingyao's heart moved when she heard Lu Ming's words.
really!
Senior brother wants me to seek a breakthrough between life and death!
With such good intentions, I will never let you down!
Thinking of this, she solemnly responded: "Yes!
Senior brother!
Junior sister must try her best to live up to the test of senior brother! "
